data.body: STATUS 2026-09-04: child diamond-miniscule-dassie (identity) is plan-review CERTIFIED after three rounds (round-1 block: principal seam unspecified on PAT/JWKS paths → SDK get_access_token(); round-2 block: Codex env_http_headers uncited → cited + probe-gated). The remaining children are depends_on-blocked until it closes, so the gate fast-fails them by design — review them in order as each prerequisite lands: nephelite-sediment-apatosaur → {misleading-wizardly-yellowlegs, mysterious-zodiacal-fruitbat} → strained-lying-steed; aerobic-seraphic-blowfish after inbox + notice. Review THIS epic last (its attestation pins every child's material; a child edit during its own review would stale it). Expect each review to take 15-20 min and to need one or two remediation rounds; the pattern from round 1-2: cite every asserted external/library capability with a path:line or URL, or gate it on a probe.
